summary: AI meeting recorder that transcribes and summarizes calls, with a REST API, webhooks and an MCP server.
access_note: Users generate an API key in User Settings; public OAuth apps for other users are subject to Fathom review.
blocker_note: Distributing an OAuth app to other Fathom users is subject to review.

evidence.quote: All REST API resources are authenticated with API keys generated via the Fathom website's settings area.
If you’re developing a public app that you wish to integrate with Fathom, you should build it using OAuth.
They are subject to review to ensure the best experience for all users.
Head to the API Access section of your User Settings and generate an API key.
This documentation describes Fathom's REST API.
Fathom is available as an official connector in Claude

notes: Docs do not state which Fathom plans include API access. Resources: meetings, recordings summary/transcript, teams, team members, webhooks. MCP quote and URL from the Claude MCP page; sign-in method is an authorization prompt.

review.reason: api_styles and mcp quotes did not support REST/official-MCP claims; replaced. OAuth public-app evidence now quotes the review sentence in its own right.
